name: Lynn Rossy
reason: Health restore, re-checked 12 Nov 2026: still out. Her work is mindful eating (the Eat for Life programme, The Mindfulness-Based Eating Solution, Savor Every Bite) as a health psychologist, and diet or eating programmes and books are always out under the restore rules; she is also president of The Center for Mindful Eating, a professional body. Two web searches found no personal website of her own (only an eOmega page, which is never fetched, Insight Timer, mindful.org and retailer pages), so there is no source for a bio, offerings or a contact route either.
